defects.title: Cover letter states facts the candidate profile never provided (invented name, metrics, job-board source); the cover-letter prompt has no grounding rule (kevin333353/jobsmith#16)
defects.expected_behavior: The cover letter only restates and emphasizes facts present in the candidate profile and job description; it must not invent names, achievements, metrics or where the opening was found.
defects.observed_behavior: In both rounds the generated letter adds facts absent from the profile: a made-up Chinese name for Alex Chen (陳彥廷 / 陳奕辰), collaboration and operational details, and in round-2 a claim that the opening was seen on 104 and CakeResume (taken from quoted untrusted input; no fetch happened). The original run invented "millions of records per day" and "about 40% faster reports". Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (84a5a2000f46).
